# Frozen migration fixtures

`v0_1_0_*` is copied from commit `921859b7bcfa9e6e80ffb78672474874332dd03d`, where the contract version was `0.1.0`. The Rust schema beside the JSON is an explicit copy of that release schema.

These files are immutable migration inputs. There is intentionally no update or generation command; add a new versioned fixture instead of rewriting one.
